A living eye chipped free from the rocky crust of a Petrified Eye. Its pupil darts around on its own, watching the world with quiet curiosity.

Acts as a catalyst of consciousness. Fusing it to compatible gear—such as a §5Beer Mug§r—awakens the item's latent sentience, giving it animated expressions and unique abilities.

§6Awakening at the Smithing Table§r

Combine an §bEcho Shard§r (Template), the target item (Base), and the §5Awakened Eye§r (Addition). The shard's deep resonance binds the living eye to the object.
